cases.name: Feeding Our Future
cases.description: Largest pandemic fraud case in US history. Federal child nutrition program funds allegedly stolen through fake meal sites claiming to feed thousands of children who never received meals.
cases.latestUpdate: Aimee Bock ordered to forfeit $5.2M. Trials ongoing, 28+ convicted so far.

cases.name: CCAP Daycare Fraud Investigation
cases.description: Minnesota's Child Care Assistance Program investigated for widespread fraud. HHS froze all payments to Minnesota. Viral video by Nick Shirley exposed daycares still receiving payments despite being closed. Trump administration extended freeze to all 50 states pending audit.
cases.latestUpdate: Trump administration froze childcare funds nationwide. House Oversight Committee announcing hearings. DCYF conducting site visits. Federal audit reveals oversight flaws.

cases.name: Housing Stabilization Services
cases.description: Program terminated after investigators found widespread billing fraud. Providers allegedly billed for services never rendered to disabled and elderly Minnesotans.

cases.name: Minnesota Daycare Fraud Investigation
cases.description: Large-scale investigation into suspected fraud in Minnesota's daycare and pandemic loan programs
cases.latestUpdate: SBA suspends nearly 7,000 Minnesota borrowers over suspected $400M pandemic loan fraud

cases.name: Minnesota Childcare Fraud Investigation
cases.description: The Trump administration has frozen childcare funding nationwide due to an expanding fraud investigation in Minnesota.
cases.latestUpdate: Nationwide childcare funding freeze. Investigation ongoing with multiple sources reporting.
